answer: Each submission hangs on the karst of a task receipt, and the jade is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. Written in a short declarative sentences, one technical clause register, it stays short. What survives to the ledge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
